item.title: AWS CLI & Permissions Setup
item.description:
AWS CLI AWS IAM

Estimated duration: 15 mins

Before building the FinOps pipeline, verify your AWS CLI profile and target Region.

Step 1 — Verify AWS CLI Identity

Run the following command in PowerShell:

aws sts get-caller-identity --profile DatTran

Confirm that your Account ID and IAM role/user identity are active.

Step 2 — Verify Target Region

This workshop uses Asia Pacific (Sydney) — ap-southeast-2.

Ensure your AWS Management Console and CLI defaults are set to ap-southeast-2 before provisioning CloudFormation stacks.

item.title: QuickSight Account Onboarding
item.description:
Amazon QuickSight

Estimated duration: 10 mins

Verify that Amazon QuickSight is active in your account and has permissions to access S3 billing buckets and Athena databases.

Step 1 — Verify QuickSight Permissions

  1. Open Amazon QuickSight → Admin Settings → Security & Permissions.
  2. Ensure Amazon S3 and Amazon Athena are checked under AWS service access.
